Light corresponding notch(4,2) has red vertical edge from(4,4) and blue horizontal edge to(-4,2). Under180 the entire red/blue edge pattern maps exactly. The small white notch opening is90 degrees because its two existing edges are perpendicular; the polygon reflex interior there is270, not90. This is a local boundary angle, not a new rotation angle condition. Both arrowheads, all sloped lines, centerC, original dark/gray uncolored portions and shared centralZ remain unchanged. Literal colored edging still maps exactly under180, and the full corner mean still excludes every other angle.
